topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I reckon that there's somethin' not right 'bout that new place ye bought. Hear tell, there's a room what was walled up, hidden like secrets from the devil. Why would anyone do such a thing? It ain't natural, and it don't sit well with me. The walls of a home should be open, honest, like the sky and the earth. This is the work of some mischief, mark my words. I've heard whispers 'bout cursed spaces, where the saints don't tread. I'd sooner plow my field twice over on a Sabbath than live in a house with shadows behind the walls. Ye best be careful, or the very stones might turn on ye.
